units.source_text: 正在此时，源氏从西厅里拉开纸隔扇，走出来了。

en.t: Just then, Genji slid open the paper partition from the west hall and came out.

units.source_text: 他说：“真不好受，这样厉害的风！

en.t: He said, "How unpleasant this is, with such a fierce wind!

units.source_text: 把格子窗都关起来吧。

en.t: Close all the lattice shutters.

units.source_text: 生怕有男客来探望。

en.t: I am afraid some male visitor may come to call.

units.source_text: 外面望进来都看得见呢。”

en.t: Anyone looking in from outside can see everything."

units.source_text: 夕雾再走过来一看，但见源氏正在对紫姬说话，带着微笑向她注视。

en.t: When Yugiri came closer and looked again, he saw Genji speaking to Lady Murasaki, gazing at her with a smile.

units.source_text: 他觉得这个人不像是他的父亲，年轻而貌美，竟是一个盛年男子。

en.t: To him, this man hardly seemed like his father; young and handsome, he looked like a man in the full prime of life.

units.source_text: 紫姬也正值青春年华，真是一对十全无缺的佳偶。

en.t: Lady Murasaki too was in the bloom of youth, and they truly made a flawless pair.

units.source_text: 他看了不禁真心地叹羡。

en.t: Seeing them, he could not help admiring them from the heart.

units.source_text: 但这渡廊东面的格子窗也已被风吹开，他站立的地方很显著。

en.t: But the lattice shutter on the east side of the passage had also been blown open, and the place where he stood was very exposed.

units.source_text: 他害怕起来，立即退去。

en.t: He grew frightened and withdrew at once.

units.source_text: 于是装作刚才来到的样子，走向檐前，咳嗽一声。

en.t: Then, pretending he had only just arrived, he went toward the eaves and gave a cough.

units.source_text: 源氏在里面说：“果然不出我所料，有人来了。

en.t: From inside, Genji said, "Just as I expected, someone has come.

units.source_text: 外面望得见呢。”

en.t: One can see in from outside."

units.source_text: 这时候他才注意到边门开着。

en.t: Only then did he notice that the side door was open.

units.source_text: 夕雾想道：“多年以来，我从未见过这位继母一面。

en.t: Yugiri thought, "For many years, I have never once seen this stepmother of mine.

units.source_text: 有道是：大风吹得岩石起，的确不错。

en.t: The saying that a great wind can lift even rocks is true indeed.

units.source_text: 我托大风之福，看到了防范如此周密的美人，真乃稀世的幸运啊！”

en.t: Thanks to this great wind, I have seen a beauty so carefully guarded; what rare good fortune!"

units.source_text: 这时候许多家臣赶到了，报告道：“这风大得可怕！

en.t: Just then, many retainers hurried over and reported, "This wind is terrifyingly strong!

units.source_text: 是从东北方吹来的，这里可保无事。

en.t: It is blowing from the northeast, so this place should remain safe.

units.source_text: 马场殿和南边的钓殿有些儿危险。”

en.t: The riding-ground hall and the fishing pavilion to the south are somewhat in danger."

units.source_text: 大家扰扰攘攘地从事防御。

en.t: Everyone bustled about noisily, setting to work on protective measures.
